remarks: Discover the perfect blend of charm and convenience in this delightful 2-bedroom, 1-bath apartment, ideally situated in a prime location. Just steps away from town, with easy access to the train, shopping, and parks, you'll have everything you need within walking distance. Inside, enjoy a warm, cozy atmosphere complemented by a newly renovated full bathroom, adding a modern touch to this quaint space. With its welcoming design and unique character, this apartment offers an inviting space that feels like home from the moment you step inside. Truly adorable and full of personality-don't miss out on this gem! (Furnishings belong to tenant - some things are for sale. This apartment comes unfurnished. Electricty and water included in rent. Tenant pays for heat/oil)
